question: On a sum, simple interest at the annual rate of 10 percent for 8 years is Rs. 8000. What will be the compound interest on the same sum at the annual rate of 10 percent (compounding annually) for 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹8000

Rate (r) = 10% per annum

Time (t) = 8 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

Compound Interest (CI) = P(1+dfrac{r}{100})^t - P 

**Calculations:**

8000 = dfrac{P times 10 times 8}{100}

⇒ 8000 = dfrac{P times 80}{100}

⇒ P = dfrac{8000 times 100}{80}

⇒ P = ₹10000

Now, for Compound Interest:

CI = 10000(1+dfrac{10}{100})³ - 10000

⇒ CI = 10000(1.1)³ - 10000

⇒ CI = 10000(1.331) - 10000

⇒ CI = ₹3310

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 3310**
